$comment: Declarative-only. Agents READ this; nobody writes status here. State is derived from the filesystem (see scripts/lib/state.mjs and AGENTS.md). Run `pnpm queue` to see the current derived state of every feature. This list contains ONLY harness-shaped launch work for the 0.2.0 release — the master roadmap (including human-owned checkpoints like design, release pipeline, and launch QA) lives in ROADMAP.md. Post-launch features (blog template, add command, scaffolded test suite, registry blocks, deploy customization) are recorded in ROADMAP.md's version ladder, not here.
description: Spec-driven feature backlog for the 0.2.0 launch. Human-owned. The leader picks the lowest-id pending feature and dispatches. See ROADMAP.md for the full launch picture.

features.name: templates-ship-prettier-formatting
features.title: Templates: ship prettier formatting config in scaffolded output
features.description: ROADMAP.md Checkpoint 5. Both templates ship ESLint already; formatting is missing. Ship prettier + prettier-plugin-astro config and a format script in the scaffolded output of starter and docs, so a fresh scaffold has the full lint+format toolchain out of the box. Also closes the registry verification blind spot: packages/registry has no lint/typecheck scripts and the better-tailwindcss ESLint rules disable themselves on registry files (no tailwind dep), so the atom source of truth escapes the canonical-class gate that its template mirrors enforce.
acceptance: packages/templates/{starter,docs} each ship a prettier config (with prettier-plugin-astro) and format / format:check scripts in package.json
A fresh scaffold of each template passes its own format:check and lint with zero errors and zero warnings
apps/site and apps/docs mirror the config; packages/astro-ignite/templates/ cache refreshed via copy-templates

packages/registry gains lint and typecheck scripts wired into the workspace recursion; the better-tailwindcss rules run for real on registry sources (entryPoint or tailwind devDep resolved) and pass clean
No new runtime dependency in any template package.json (devDependencies only)
pnpm scaffold:test passes; a changeset documents the addition

features.name: docs-site-customization-guides
features.title: Docs site: six how-to customization guides
features.description: ROADMAP.md Checkpoint 3. docs.astroignite.dev currently only answers 'what is this?'. Add the six how-to guides (closed list): theming/tokens (the showpiece), adding content (blog post / project / docs page), adding a locale, deploying (CF Pages / Netlify / Vercel / Node + contact form on static hosts), contact-form email setup (Resend/SMTP), using components. English first; Spanish translated once content freezes. Distill from the templates' own docs/ deep-dives where possible. Wording must never imply an `add` command exists.
acceptance: Six guide pages exist under apps/docs/src/content/docs/en/ covering: theming, adding content, adding a locale, deploying, contact-form email, using components
Every claim is verified against the shipped 0.2.0-to-be templates (no stale layered-CSS or adapter claims)
No page implies an `astro-ignite add` command exists
Spanish translations land in es/ once the English content is frozen (key-parallel sidebar)
pnpm typecheck and the docs-site build pass; Lighthouse budget not regressed

features.name: docs-site-component-reference
features.title: Docs site: component reference for every registry item
features.description: ROADMAP.md Checkpoint 3. One reference page per registry item (23 UI items + cn lib — incl. the four form atoms select/checkbox/radio-group/switch from Checkpoint 2b), each with a live demo via the docs template's ComponentShowcase, a code example, a props table, and 'ships pre-installed in both templates — copy from the registry to use elsewhere'. No add-command wording.
acceptance: One page per registry.json item under apps/docs (23 registry:ui + cn), each rendering a live ComponentShowcase demo, an import/usage code example, and a props table
Compound families (card, tabs, accordion, dialog, dropdown-menu) document all their parts on the family page
No page implies an `astro-ignite add` command exists
English first, Spanish after content freeze
pnpm typecheck and the docs-site build pass; Lighthouse budget not regressed

features.name: templates-ai-ready-skills
features.title: Templates: ship .claude/skills/ so agents follow the locked practices
features.description: ROADMAP.md Checkpoint 4. Scaffolded output ships agent skills that proceduralize the best practices. Starter: add-blog-post, add-project, add-page (page + [lang]/ parallel + nav + JSON-LD node), add-locale. Docs: add-doc-page, add-locale. One reserved slot for a seventh skill (e.g. customize-theme once the design-phase token story settles). Hard cap: 7 skills.
acceptance: packages/templates/starter ships .claude/skills/ with add-blog-post, add-project, add-page, add-locale; packages/templates/docs ships add-doc-page, add-locale

Acceptance per skill (the AI-ready bar): fresh scaffold, Claude Code cold with no extra context, one-line request — the result passes pnpm typecheck && pnpm build plus the relevant invariant audits, and renders in both locales when two are configured
scaffold.ts ships the skills in the output (and the _gitignore handling keeps them)
packages/astro-ignite/templates/ cache refreshed; pnpm scaffold:test passes
A changeset documents the addition

features.name: starter-demo-blog-content
features.title: Starter: demo content that exercises every blog feature
features.description: ROADMAP.md Checkpoint 2. DEPENDS ON THE DESIGN CHECKPOINT (hero images come from the claude-design banner pipeline) — do not start until ROADMAP Checkpoint 1 lands. With only 2 posts, pagination never triggers, related posts are trivial, and the tag index is nearly empty. Ship ~5-6 posts (en + es) with overlapping tags, 2-3 projects, so a fresh scaffold demonstrates pagination, related posts, tags, ToC, and reading time on first pnpm dev.
acceptance: Starter ships enough posts (en + es, key-parallel) to trigger at least one pagination break and meaningful related-posts/tag-index surfaces
Every hero image is generated via the claude-design banner pipeline (no hand-rolled SVGs)
2-3 example projects ship in the projects collection
pnpm scaffold:test passes; pnpm perf:budget holds the Lighthouse budget on /blog and a post page
A changeset documents the change
